answersJson.title: Answers JSON
answersJson.description: Carries all collected answers across every turn. Pass from previous action output.

currentQuestionKey.title: Current Question Key
currentQuestionKey.description: Key of the current question being presented. Pass from previous response.

intakeSessionId.title: Intake Session Id
intakeSessionId.description: Unique session identifier. Pass from previous action output to resume session.

routableId.title: Routable Id
routableId.description: Messaging session or voice call record id. Pass from system context when available.

smartIntakeContextKey.title: SmartIntake Context Key
smartIntakeContextKey.description: Route key for SmartIntake. Set from $Context.Current_Page so Apex can resolve the template from routing metadata. Do not ask the user for this value.
